activity_summary: The forty leaves are open at the hollow crown. The two lines are under your finger. Dick's hand is on the table beside the sheet, and it has not moved. You are reading, not mending.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the two lines under a finger and did not revise them.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Left his hand flat beside the leaf.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Sit upon the ground

facets.activity: Kept the leaf open where the king sits on the ground
